company.description: VoiceOps provides a conversation intelligence platform that focuses on coaching and training for sales teams. The platform captures and analyzes call data, offering insights into how sales representatives communicate with prospects and customers. It is designed to identify behaviors, measure adherence to sales processes, and highlight areas for improvement. VoiceOps enables managers to track coaching effectiveness and ensure that strategies are consistently applied across teams.
